what: iOS 27 UIAlertController (alert and action sheet) on the device
probe: tool/ios_reference scene x3alert (Sources/Extras.swift): alert/actionsheet-present-dismiss from scripted presents (devicectl, night pass); the rest from synthesized touches (UITests/ExtrasUITests.swift testX3Device, morning)
rows: start; touch; evt (script, present, presented, action); V cls _UIAlertControllerPhoneTVMacView = the alert platter (center, size, bounds), _UIPopoverView = the action sheet popover (sx, sy its scale)

files.alert-press.jsonl: a 0.6 s press on OK (the platter lift)
files.alert-slide.jsonl: press OK, slide down over Delete and 228 pt below the platter, release (drag lean down)
files.alert-lean.jsonl: press OK, drag 120 pt right, 120 left and 112 down, back to Cancel, release (drag lean both ways)
files.ash-press.jsonl: an action sheet with a source: a 0.6 s press on OK, slide 60 pt down, release (no lift; dismissal on the action)
files.ash-tap-out.jsonl: an action sheet with a source: a tap outside (dismissal)

units: points (pt), window coordinates, seconds on the device media clock
